title: Web Application Firewall
domain_info: ModSecurity v3 + OWASP Core Rule Set. The nginx vhost is re-rendered on save (zero downtime).

module_not_installed.title: The ModSecurity module is not installed on the server.
module_not_installed.desc_before: Settings are saved but the WAF is not applied. It activates automatically once
module_not_installed.desc_after: is run on the server (existing sites are unaffected).

devral.title: Inherit from Plan
devral.desc: This domain uses the WAF default of its assigned service plan.

engelle.title: Block
engelle.desc: Malicious requests (SQLi, XSS, RCE…) are blocked with a 403. SecRuleEngine On.

denetle.title: Detect
denetle.desc: Requests aren't blocked; matching rules are only written to the audit log. DetectionOnly — ideal for tuning rules.

kapali.title: Off
kapali.desc: WAF is fully disabled for this domain (even if the plan has it on).

paranoia.title: Paranoia Level (CRS)
paranoia.desc1: Higher level = more rules + stronger protection, but a higher chance of false positives.
paranoia.desc2_prefix: Only effective while the WAF is in
paranoia.hint1: Low — basic attack signatures. Almost no false positives. (recommended)
paranoia.hint2: Medium — more rules. Some legitimate requests may be blocked.
paranoia.hint3: High — aggressive. May require tuning (exclusions) per application.
paranoia.hint4: Strict — most aggressive. Only for cases requiring strict auditing.
paranoia.high_level_warning: At levels 3-4, ModSecurity/OWASP CRS runs a large number of rules on every request; this can noticeably increase CPU usage and request latency. Use with caution on resource-limited servers.

saved_inactive_msg: ✓ Setting saved — WAF is inactive for this domain
